pages.text: Blazes that live in the drought-scorched hills burn hotter and hit harder than ordinary ones - and with your experience, bending them to your will is no trouble at all.

Right-click your Drought Blaze Servant with $(item)Blaze Powder$() to heal it.$(br)You can summon this blaze by ritual, or call it quickly with a $(l:supreme/items/drought_blaze_focus)Drought Blaze Focus$().
